Overfitting

Overfitting happens when a model learns the noise of the training data instead of the signal. It performs well on training data but poorly on unseen data.

How to prevent it

  • Use more training data.
  • Apply regularization such as L1 or L2.
  • Use cross-validation.

Bias-variance tradeoff

High bias models underfit; high variance models overfit. The goal is to balance both.
